# LastFix
> "You fixed it before. You just forgot how."

LastFix is an empirical personal troubleshooting memory system powered by local open-weight AI (Gemma 3 4B via Ollama) and SQLite FTS5.
It stores the exact steps users tried when troubleshooting computer, hardware, network, and coding issues, distinguishing failed attempts from the confirmed fix.

## Core Capabilities
- Natural Language Extraction: Converts unstructured incident descriptions into ordered attempts with explicit outcomes ("worked", "failed", "unknown").
- Context Deduction: Infers device, operating system, situation trigger, and subsystem.
- Evidence-Based Diagnostic Recall: Surfaces previously failed attempts with warnings ("Last time, this did not resolve the issue") and highlights the confirmed fix.
- True Offline Resilience: Self-contained frontend bundle and local Ollama inference guarantee total offline functionality and privacy.
